intro: If you've got an early-morning flight out of U-Tapao Airport, or you've just landed late at night and don't want the long drive into Pattaya, J L Residence Hotel is the stay that fits that exact need · It's a small budget residence with around 24 rooms in Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip, only about 3-7 kilometers from U-Tapao International Airport (UTP), a 5-10 min drive, with an airport shuttle service · What guests talk about is the hard-to-find location near the airport, the quiet setting, free parking, and prices that start in the low thousands of baht · Prices start at about THB 900-1,200/night · Scored 7.4 from 219 reviews and awarded Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice

body.html: An overview of J L Residence Hotel and who it suits — to put it the way you'd tell a friend, J L Residence Hotel isn't a place that sells luxury or a long list of facilities · It's a small budget residence with around 24 rooms that clearly sells two things: a hard-to-find location near U-Tapao Airport (UTP) and prices that start in the low thousands of baht · The people this suits best are travelers with an early-morning or late-night flight at U-Tapao who want a clean, quiet place to crash as close to the gate as possible, without risking a 3 a.m. wake-up and a long drive from Pattaya to catch the plane · Another group it fits well is staff, crew, technicians, or anyone working in the Sattahip-Phlu Ta Luang area, U-Tapao Airport, the naval base, or the EEC zone who needs a nightly or longer stay on a budget · And anyone driving themselves has the advantage here, because the free private parking is easier than the beachfront zones where cars pack in on weekends · On the flip side, if you're a family wanting a pool, kids' activities and full beach-resort service, or you're mainly here to enjoy Pattaya and want to stay in the city center, this place may not fit, since it's fairly far out toward Sattahip · Put simply, J L Residence suits people coming to "stay cheap and close to the airport" more than people chasing a full resort experience, and it's a stay you'll be happy with only if you set your expectations right before booking

Location and getting around — J L Residence Hotel sits at 11/193 Moo 2, Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip, Chon Buri · This is a location you need to understand clearly before booking, because it isn't the Pattaya zone or the main tourist beaches most people picture, but a Sattahip suburban area that is very close to U-Tapao-Rayong-Pattaya International Airport (UTP) · Booking platforms list it as only about 3-7 kilometers from the airport, or a 5-10 min drive, which is its number-one selling point, and the hotel offers an airport shuttle service (paid) for those who aren't driving themselves · The charm of this location is that you get suburban calm, a quiet setting, and the most convenient spot if your main business is flying · Around the Sattahip side there are highlights including Khao Phlu Ta Luang, the Naval Aviation Museum, the Sattahip beaches and Khao Chi Chan (the Buddha image carved into the cliff face), all within a short drive · Pattaya city, Jomtien and Ban Amphoe beach are about 20-40 min away by car depending on the destination · One thing to say plainly is that this location all but requires a car or the hotel's shuttle — it's outside the main tourist spots, getting a taxi or public transport is fairly hard, and there aren't dense rows of shops around the property like in the city · As for getting in from Bangkok, Sattahip is at the end of Motorway 7, a roughly 2 to 2.5-hour drive depending on traffic · In short, if your business is tied to U-Tapao Airport or the Sattahip area, this location is a clear advantage, but if you're set on a pure Pattaya trip without a car, weigh it carefully

"Clean room, comfy bed, nice and quiet, big easy parking · We picked this place because we had an early flight out of U-Tapao, and the drive from the hotel to the airport is just a few minutes, so no need to get up before dawn. Great value for the price, but you really need your own car — there's not much around."

Rooms and decor — J L Residence Hotel has around 24 rooms, split mainly into Standard-style rooms and larger Deluxe or Family rooms for groups · Rooms are air-conditioned with garden views, decorated in a simple residence style — nothing flashy but genuinely usable · In-room amenities are complete for a budget stay: AC, wardrobe, work desk, flat-screen TV, fridge, seating area, and a private bathroom with basic toiletries · There's free Wi-Fi, which travelers who need to work or handle things online before a flight care about · Most real reviews say the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, and it's quiet, well suited to an overnight stay before or after a flight and to unhurried rest · What draws praise is the value for the price — you get a complete, clean room in the low-thousands-of-baht range · But to be straight, since it's a small budget stay, you can run into the usual notes for this level: basic decor, occasionally not every in-room item is stocked, and standards may vary a bit room to room · Overall the rooms deliver good budget value, as long as you understand you're paying in the low thousands of baht mainly for cleanliness and a location near the airport, not for a luxurious room

Facilities and common areas — as a small residence, J L Residence Hotel has no swimming pool, and to be straight, anyone looking for a pool or spa should consider somewhere else from the start · But what it does have, and does well in its own way, is free private parking — a real plus for people driving themselves or running errands around Sattahip-U-Tapao, easy to park without competing for a spot · There's a gym for anyone wanting a light workout during their stay, a shared lounge and terrace for sitting out in the breeze, and a 24-hour front desk that matters a lot for a stay near the airport, because it handles late check-ins and early-morning check-outs for people on off-hours flights · There's laundry and ironing service, useful for longer stays or people working in the area · There's free Wi-Fi throughout · On policies worth knowing, pets aren't allowed, and young children up to age 5 carry a small extra charge if using the existing bed · Overall the common areas at J L Residence are "just enough" — nothing luxurious, but the 24-hour front desk, free parking, gym, and the quiet near the airport add up to fit the main purpose of this kind of stay nicely for the price

Food and the on-site restaurant — J L Residence Hotel has an in-house restaurant and serves Asian-style breakfast for guests, a basic, filling menu before heading out or boarding, not fancy but right for the size and price level of the stay · Some reviews say there's room-delivery service and that special menu requests can sometimes be accommodated, so it's worth asking ahead · One thing to understand is that this is a Sattahip suburban area, so there aren't dense rows of shops or restaurants around the property like in the city — especially at night, if you don't have a car it can be inconvenient to find food nearby, so plan to grab some supplies, or use the local delivery services that are available to some extent · The upside is that if you have a car, a short drive gets you to markets and restaurants in Sattahip town, plus the seafood and fresh-from-the-sea spots on the Sattahip-Ban Amphoe coast that are the charm of this area · So many people use J L Residence as a base near the airport and head out to eat in town or pick up supplies before returning, which fits the "use the hotel as a stopover before and after a flight" style more than sitting down for every meal at the hotel

Service — service at J L Residence Hotel is an area where review voices lean fairly positive for a stay this size · On the plus side, many reviews say the staff are helpful, attentive, and there's a 24-hour front desk that works for people on off-hours flights, so whether you check in late or leave before dawn, someone's there to handle it · The airport shuttle service (paid) also makes travel much easier for people without a car, since the distance is short and easy to manage · Because it's a small stay, the staff can look after guests closely, like staying at the home of someone you know · But the part to say plainly, in the nature of a small budget stay, is that service standards may not be as consistent as a big hotel chain at certain times or with certain people, and English communication may be a bit limited for international travelers · On top of that, this kind of stay may have prepayment or deposit policies on some booking channels, so read the terms clearly before you book · Overall, service is "good for the size and price," and the 24-hour front desk is the real strength for a stay near the airport

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulling together opinions from Trip.com, Booking.com, Tripadvisor and other booking platforms, the picture is fairly consistent for a budget stay near the airport · On the praise side: the location near U-Tapao Airport is the most convenient for people with a flight, rooms are clean and beds comfortable, the setting is quiet and good for rest, free parking is easy, the 24-hour front desk handles off-hours flights, there's an airport shuttle, and it's good value at low-thousands-of-baht prices · Many people sum it up as "not a luxury hotel, but good value and genuinely close to the airport," and the overall 7.4 from 219 reviews, plus a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice award, reflect that picture · On the notes side: the most-mentioned point is the location outside the main tourist spots and the quiet around the property — without a car it's hard to find food or get around the area, and it's not suited if you're mainly here for Pattaya · Next is that it's a small budget stay, so it has no pool and the facilities aren't full like a resort · Followed by room and service standards that may vary a bit, in the nature of a small stay, and in-room items occasionally not being complete · These gripes are mostly things you can manage by understanding you're booking a budget stay near the airport, not a beachfront resort, rather than flaws beyond what's acceptable

"Stayed before an early-morning flight, great value, the front desk is staffed 24 hours so checking in late was no problem. Clean room, quiet, slept comfortably · The only downside is it's a bit too quiet around here, and at night it's hard to find food without a car, so buy supplies beforehand. But for anyone with a U-Tapao flight, it's great value and very convenient."

Price comparison and value — prices start at about THB 900-1,200/night for a standard room on weekdays, and larger rooms or ones for groups go up a bit more by size and season · On weekends, long holidays, and during events in the Sattahip-U-Tapao area, prices rise and rooms fill fast because there are only about 24 of them · Compared with other stays in the same area, J L Residence sits in the budget group that's good value for a specific goal: staying near U-Tapao Airport · What you get back at this price is a clean room, a quiet setting, free parking, a 24-hour front desk, and a distance to the airport so short it has almost no rival on the same budget · What you trade is no pool, not a full set of facilities, a location that needs a car, and a quiet area · For people whose main business is tied to the airport or the Sattahip area, and who value getting good value and an easy boarding more than a full resort, this price is very worthwhile · But if you measure by full-resort completeness or a Pattaya trip without a car, the same budget might do better with a stay in the Pattaya-Jomtien zone · The 7.4 from 219 reviews and the Travelers' Choice award reflect this picture exactly — a budget stay that does its job well on a tight budget and hits its target clearly

Things to know before booking — a few things help make the stay smoother · One, this stay stands out for being close to U-Tapao Airport, ideal if you have an early-morning or late-night flight — if you don't have a car, ask about and book the airport shuttle service (paid) ahead of time · Two, you should have your own car or plan your travel in the area, because the location is outside the main tourist spots, taxis are hard to get, and it's quiet around the property — the upside is free, easy parking · Three, if you arrive at night, buy some food beforehand, because there aren't dense rows of shops around · Four, make use of the 24-hour front desk and give your actual check-in and check-out times by your flight in advance · Five, check clearly whether the rate you book includes breakfast, and read the payment/deposit terms of your booking channel in detail · Six, the stay has around 24 rooms, and during long holidays or local events rooms fill fast, so book ahead and compare prices across several platforms (Agoda, Booking, Trip.com) · Seven, this place doesn't allow pets and has no pool, so set your expectations right

In summary — from all the real reviews, J L Residence Hotel is the best fit for people who want a budget, clean, quiet stay as close to U-Tapao Airport as possible — whether you have an early-morning flight, land late, or come to work in the Sattahip-U-Tapao area and the EEC zone · A location that's a few minutes' drive from the airport, an airport shuttle, a 24-hour front desk, free parking, and clean rooms make it a budget stay with a clear purpose and good value in the Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip area · If you're expecting a beachfront resort with a pool, full service, a central Pattaya location, and easy travel without a car, this isn't the answer, and you should look at hotels in the Pattaya-Jomtien zone instead · But if you're after a stay near U-Tapao Airport in the few-thousand-baht range, quiet, easy to drive to, and good value — J L Residence Hotel does that job well, and it's why many guests say it's "worth what you pay and genuinely right for anyone with a U-Tapao flight."
